ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15:85 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels; white pixels are concentrated at the distal tips and the peduncle insertion zone.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; a horizontal band of white pixels is visible at the central base where the fluke meets the water line; the majority of the fluke body is a solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire upper boundary (trailing edge); characterized by irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys, particularly prominent on the inner margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning into a sharp upward convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the outer tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged traumatic indentations along the trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from natural serration patterns.
